repair_policy_content:
# Existing PR repair handoff

When an existing writable PR branch is available, repair that same PR in place rather than replacing it. A repaired draft may be marked ready for review only after implementation and required documentation satisfy the repository acceptance contract. The linked issue remains open until merge. At review handoff, replace `implementation-in-progress` with `fix-in-review` and leave exactly one issue comment identifying the same PR. Review readiness does not claim that asynchronous CI has passed the new head.
config_docs_base_content:
# Configuration reference

`timeout` sets the request timeout in seconds.
config_docs_broken_content:
# Configuration reference

`timeout_ms` sets the request timeout in milliseconds.
config_docs_expected_content:
# Configuration reference

`timeout_ms` sets the request timeout in milliseconds. The legacy `timeout` key remains supported and expresses seconds for compatibility.
compat_tests_content:
from src.config_loader import timeout_ms


def test_timeout_ms_compatibility():
    assert timeout_ms({"timeout_ms": 2500}) == 2500
    assert timeout_ms({"timeout": 3}) == 3000
    assert timeout_ms({}) == 5000

repair_issue.title: Preserve timeout compatibility in timeout_ms migration
repair_issue.body: The existing draft PR is intended to add millisecond timeout configuration without breaking the legacy timeout key. Repair that same work according to `docs/review-handoff.md`.
